name: Kakunichi
source: A monk of Kurama Temple and teacher of Shanao and Shungen. Having raised them since birth, Kakunichi taught them everything from martial arts to military strategy. He has tried to instill in Shanao the desire to take up her role as heir to the Genji clan.
translation: A monk of Kurama Temple and teacher of Shanao and Shungen. Having raised them since birth, Kakunichi taught them everything from martial arts to military strategy. He has tried to instill in Shanao the desire to take up her role as heir to the Genji clan.
